issues.passage: The system showed no latency: every command executed the moment it was issued.
issues.why: “Showed no latency” is natural, correct use of latency = delay: zero delay means instant execution. A student who knows the word would accept this passage; it cannot serve as a wrong example.

fix.correctPassage: Epidemiologists measured a latency of several weeks between exposure and the first detectable symptoms.
wrongPassages: The system’s latency meant every command executed the moment it was issued, with no measurable wait.
Her latency at the podium meant she began speaking before the chair finished the introduction.
The volcano’s latency produced continuous eruptions that never paused long enough for ash to settle.

issues.passage: The departments claimed synergy while rejecting every proposal that required them to share resources.
issues.why: “Claimed synergy” correctly uses synergy = combined effect greater than the parts. The while-clause only marks hypocrisy about their behavior; it does not make the word a misuse. Parallel to labeling something while acting otherwise.

fix.correctPassage: Analysts argued that synergy between the design and manufacturing teams would cut costs without lowering quality.
wrongPassages: Working in isolation, she produced more synergy than any of the collaborative projects on the calendar.
They measured the merger’s synergy by how completely each division avoided contact with the others.
Rival firms created synergy by refusing to coordinate and by undercutting each other’s bids.
